ogDesc: The 6 closest stays to Bangkok Hospital, with real distances and prices.
intro: Bangkok Hospital (BDMS headquarters) sits deep inside Soi Soonvijai, also signed as Soi Phetchaburi 47, off New Phetchaburi Road near Phetchaburi MRT and the Makkasan Airport Rail Link. The lane itself has only a handful of hotels, but the ones there are built around patients and their families — many run a free shuttle to the hospital door, keep small kitchenettes for reheating meals, and offer late check-out. Below are places we checked are real and genuinely bookable, with real distances to the hospital, ordered cheapest to priciest.

blocks.html: Short answer: The hotels closest to Bangkok Hospital sit right on Soi Soonvijai (Soi Phetchaburi 47), all walkable — Shama Petchburi 47, Kepler Residence, Holiday Inn Express Soonvijai and Chiva Bangkok are a 5-minute walk or less, and several run a free shuttle to the hospital entrance. For larger serviced-apartment rooms on a longer stay, the Rama 9–RCA area is a short ride away.

blocks.text: Hotels near Bangkok Hospital, by distance & budget

items.name: Chiva Bangkok Hotel
items.meta: 📍 4-min walk (300 m) to Bangkok Hospital · ★ 3-star · Best for: Patient families · budget stays · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small hotel on Soi Soonvijai 7, about a 4-minute walk to Bangkok Hospital and the cheapest option in the lane. Rooms are studios with a fridge and a small kitchen corner for reheating food; reviewers note clean rooms, helpful staff and a special patient rate. There's no pool or gym, but for caring for a patient on a tight budget it does the job.

items.name: Holiday Inn Express Bangkok Soi Soonvijai
items.meta: 📍 2-min walk (140 m) to Bangkok Hospital · ★ 4-star · Best for: International patients · hospital shuttle · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: About 140 m from the Bangkok Hospital gate, a genuine two-minute walk, with a free tuk-tuk shuttle to Bangkok Hospital, Piyavate and Praram 9. Rooms are clean, simple Holiday Inn Express standard with a buffet breakfast and a rooftop garden, and RCA is a 4-minute drive. A good fit for international patients who want a familiar brand and easy English.

items.name: Kepler Residence Bangkok
items.meta: 📍 2-min walk (100 m) to Bangkok Hospital · ★ 4-star · Best for: Longer stays · in-room kitchen · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: The aparthotel closest to Bangkok Hospital, roughly 100 m and a two-minute walk. It has 36 units, each with a kitchen and fridge, which suits a multi-day recovery stay where you want to cook or keep refrigerated medication. There's an outdoor pool and a small gym, it's quiet, and Praram 9 and RCA are a short ride away.

items.name: Shama Petchburi 47 Bangkok
items.meta: 📍 1-min walk (90 m) to Bangkok Hospital · ★ 4-star · Best for: Family long stays · large suites · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A serviced apartment a one-minute walk from Bangkok Hospital, with 127 suites from Junior Suites up to three-bedroom units, each with separate living and sleeping areas and a kitchen with microwave. It suits families on a long bedside stay or groups, and runs a free hospital shuttle plus a pool and gym. Rates run higher than the first options, but you get more space and privacy.

items.name: Maitria Hotel Rama 9 Bangkok - A Chatrium Collection
items.meta: 📍 6-min drive (2 km) to Bangkok Hospital · ★ 4-star · Best for: Near RCA · close to the MRT · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: On the RCA side, about 2 km from Bangkok Hospital, a 6-minute drive or roughly a 15-minute walk. It's a modern 4-star in the Chatrium family with fresh rooms and a pool, and RCA is only 700 m away for restaurants and nightlife. A good pick if you don't need the hospital every single day but want a nicer base with things to do nearby and an easy ride back.

items.name: Somerset Rama 9 Bangkok
items.meta: 📍 8-min drive (2.5 km) to Bangkok Hospital · ★ 4-star · Best for: Extended stays · by Phra Ram 9 MRT · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A serviced residence on Ratchadaphisek Road by Phra Ram 9 MRT and Central Rama 9, about 2.5 km from Bangkok Hospital and an 8-minute drive. It offers studio, one- and two-bedroom units with full kitchens, which suits weeks- or months-long treatment when you want a home-like base near the MRT and a big mall. Getting to the hospital is an easy taxi or Grab hop.

faq.q: What is the easiest way to get from my hotel to Bangkok Hospital?
faq.a: If you stay on Soi Soonvijai (Soi Phetchaburi 47) at Shama Petchburi 47, Kepler Residence, Holiday Inn Express Soonvijai or Chiva Bangkok, you can simply walk in 1–5 minutes, and several run a free shuttle to the hospital door if it's raining or you can't walk far. From the RCA or Rama 9 hotels, a metered taxi or Grab is just a 6–8 minute ride.

faq.q: How do I get from the airport to the Bangkok Hospital area?
faq.a: From Suvarnabhumi Airport, take the Airport Rail Link to Makkasan, the closest station, then a taxi or Grab for about 10 minutes to Soi Soonvijai. You can also take a taxi straight from the airport, about 40–60 minutes depending on traffic. From Don Mueang Airport, a direct taxi or Grab (about 30–45 minutes) is the simplest option.

faq.q: Are there budget options close to the hospital?
faq.a: Yes — Chiva Bangkok Hotel is the cheapest in the lane, from around 1,400 THB a night for a studio with a small kitchen corner, about a 4-minute walk to the hospital. Next up is Holiday Inn Express Soonvijai from about 1,600 THB, which adds an international brand and breakfast. If you'll stay several days and want to cook, Kepler Residence, where every unit has a kitchen, works out better value for a longer stay.
